summary: Comprehensive implementation using CrewAI and Pydantic models. It addresses most requirements including truck prioritization and timely removal checks. Distance calculation is still simplified, but the structure is robust.

findings.description: Truck prioritization correctly implemented based on load percentage.
findings.evidence: models/system.py: prioritize_trucks sorts by truck.current_load / truck.capacity, reverse=True

findings.description: Timely removal check (1 day) is implemented.
findings.evidence: models/system.py: check_timely_removal checks if time_since_empty > timedelta(days=1)

findings.description: Nearest truck selection is a placeholder returning the first free truck.
findings.evidence: models/system.py: get_nearest_available_truck: # Simple implementation ... For now, just return the first free truck

findings.description: Strong logical separation between models, agents, and services using Pydantic for validation.
findings.evidence: Presence of models/ and agents/ directories with structured Pydantic classes.

implementation_risks: The 'nearest truck' logic assumes any free truck is suitable, which might fail in geographically large simulations without real distance checks.
